concerns.text: Task T003 (dry‑run end‑to‑end) is scheduled before the producer tasks that implement the pipeline components it exercises (graph extraction T004, feature engineering T005, model training T006). This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

Constitution VI (Static‑Dynamic Alignment Verification) requires an explicit verification that each generated static graph is paired with the exact dynamic execution log for the same patch. No task in the list produces or validates this alignment artifact.

Constitution VII (Failure‑Mode Categorization Rigor) mandates that the dataset contain at least one demonstrable instance for each error‑category before claiming categorization rigor. No task explicitly checks for the presence of at least one instance per taxonomy category.
